Postnatally she had nasal obstruction, inspiratory dyspnea, feeding difficulties, vomiting, apnea and cyanosis. She also had microretrognathism, microcrania, mandibular hypoplasia, low ear implantation, pre-auricular appendix, short neck and bilateral microtia.
